activityDescription: Four hours on 20, 40 and 80m: serial, name and location
ourLocationPlaceholder: State, province, NA country, or DX
qsyReminder: **QSY rule:** answer a CQ and the frequency is yours for one more contact. After any contact you solicited — a CQ, a QRZ, or that one more — move at least 1 kHz to call another station, or 5 kHz to call CQ, and don't come back until you've made a contact elsewhere.
historyFileDescription: The name and location each station sent in earlier SSB Sprints, from N1MM Logger+'s call history file, suggested as you log. Log what you copy.
